title: Times Car Mass BOLA / IDOR Scraping Simulation

incident.name: Times Car (Times Mobility) 2024 Mass Data Exposure
incident.summary: Simulates automated cross-user account/license harvesting by iterating through consecutive resource IDs with an unauthorized peer credential.
references: Times Car 2024 breach: 6.6M customer accounts and ID images exposed.

attacker_token.description: Bearer token used to test cross-tenant unauthorized access.

sample_ids.description: List of sample resource IDs to probe.

steps.name: Iterate Cross-User Endpoints
steps.description: Requests resource IDs using attacker credential, expecting 403 or 404.

recommendations.remediation: Enforce Komagu Boilerplate 1 (Object-Level Authorization) with declarative @RequireOwnership decorators or integrate Kong perimeter WAF with strict 404 invariants.
recommendations.passed: Endpoint securely enforces tenant isolation (404 Not Found invariant maintained).
